project.name: ST Score Editor Core
project.primary_product_goal: Build a professional, renderer-independent semantic score editor that can operate standalone, be embedded through a versioned SDK, and become a commercially licensable notation workstation with fast note entry, reliable semantic editing, exact Undo/Redo, safe MusicXML interchange, professional score-structure editing, renderer independence and optional audio audition.
project.product_positioning: Professional notation-workstation / Sibelius-class problem space without copying or introducing a second canonical editor architecture.

manual_gate.title: PHYSICAL-IOS: qualify P08-E4 Professional Browser Artifact
manual_gate.rule: Only explicit user-observed physical-device evidence may set this PASS. Never infer PASS from Playwright/WebKit, CI, screenshots alone or browser emulation.

historical_branch_policy.rule: Start new work from current main unless a specific recovery/migration task explicitly requires another base. Do not revive old stacked P06 or other historical branches as the current implementation base.

canonical_architecture.core_rule: No renderer, browser shell, audio engine, SDK host or persistence layer may dual-write canonical score state.

merged_professional_architecture.P08_A: Professional revision-bound EVENT_SPAN and EVENT_SET semantic selection.
merged_professional_architecture.P08_B: Professional octave transpose and rhythm-preserving Clear/Delete-to-REST over admitted selections.
merged_professional_architecture.P08_C: Staff-local key/clef, propagation-safe frame-global time signature and frame barline/repeat authoring.
merged_professional_architecture.P08_D: Unified professional workstation controller delegating to existing semantic mutation engines.
merged_professional_architecture.P08_E1: Browser professional bridge over the existing standalone controller.
merged_professional_architecture.P08_E4: Separately bounded professional browser artifact with independent manifest, checksum, byte ceiling and WebKit qualification.

professional_artifact.rule: Do not assume default-editor audio composition is available inside STScoreEditorProfessionalApp. Professional-artifact audio requires a separate bounded design and qualification stage.

next_development_track.name: Fast Entry / Keyboard Workstation
next_development_track.why_now: The largest professional-product gap is now input speed and command ergonomics. Existing semantic mutation engines are substantial and should be reused instead of creating another editor core.

first_stage.name: Existing Capability Inventory and Gap Matrix
first_stage.goal: Prove what already exists for keypad, keyboard, note insertion, rhythm commands, navigation, selection and SDK integration before implementing any new command layer.
inspect: browser keyboard handlers and focus rules
APP-10 note insertion and selected-note editing
duration/rest/dot paths and shared rhythm authority
public SDK exposure and host lifecycle
mobile behavior where desktop keyboard concepts do not apply
do_not: Do not create a second note-entry engine.
Do not create a second rhythm mutation authority.
Do not introduce a hidden cursor state before its canonical/noncanonical role is specified.
Do not change production exposure, SesliTab cutover or audio qualification in P09-A.

conditional_later_stages.name: Bounded Keyboard Command Intent Contract
conditional_later_stages.condition: Only if P09-A proves a real missing integration layer.
requirements: Route commands to existing semantic authoring primitives.
One accepted authoring command creates exactly one unified history revision.

conditional_later_stages.name: Browser Keyboard Adapter
conditional_later_stages.condition: After P09-B contract and tests pass.
requirements: preventDefault only for admitted notation commands.
Pointer/touch/keyboard paths converge on the same mutation engines.

conditional_later_stages.name: Fast Entry Workflow Qualification
requirements: Bounded duration/pitch intent to exact semantic insertion target.
Deterministic selection/caret rebound with explicitly documented authority.
Dedicated WebKit regression for the admitted workflow.

parallel_manual_work.developer_rule: Do not block P09-A inventory on the physical gate, but never close or mark the physical gate PASS autonomously.

safety_and_fail_closed_rules: Renderer coordinates, DOM/SVG ids and viewport geometry are never canonical authoring authority.
Stale SemanticAddressV3 or revision evidence fails closed before mutation.
Unsupported imported timing or topology must be rejected rather than invented.
Do not silently broaden tuplets or rhythm transformations beyond admitted profiles.
Do not invent automatic imported Voice/measure topology.
Do not add .mxl container support without separate archive/dependency/security admission.
Do not give cloud/server/host code canonical revision authority.
Do not activate unqualified audio instruments.
Do not reactivate Classical Guitar unless explicitly requested.
Do not expose STScoreEditorProfessionalApp to production before physical qualification and explicit authorization.
Do not perform SesliTab cutover without explicit authorization.

required_before_implementation_merge: exact ST Score Rendering Layer checkout/build
P08-E4 professional WebKit regression when professional/shared browser code changes
audio admission/composition regressions when shared audio-host code changes
dedicated P09 tests once implementation begins
validation_contract.bundle_budget_policy: Do not silently rebaseline default or professional bundle ceilings. Any increase needs explicit architectural evidence and review.

allowed_without_new_human_approval: Fresh-read current main and current architecture documents.
Create feature/documentation branches from current main.
Perform P09-A read-only inventory and write architecture/capability matrix documents.
Add bounded tests that only prove existing behavior.
Implement later P09 stages on a feature branch only when prior-stage evidence explicitly admits them and architecture invariants remain intact.
Run exact-head CI/regressions and fix deterministic branch-local failures without weakening safety contracts.
Open/update PRs and developer handoff documents.
Update this continuation JSON after each completed stage so the next developer resumes from the actual remaining step.
requires_explicit_human_approval: Merge into main or another protected/product branch.
SesliTab integration/cutover or external-product dependency repin.
Destructive history rewrite, force-push over shared work, or deletion of validation evidence.

developer_workflow: 1. Fresh-read main, ARCHITECTURE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md and relevant package/test files. Repository reality overrides this handoff if newer.
2. Confirm current main head. If main moved beyond e281d528..., reconcile this handoff against the new head before editing.
3. Start P09-A on a new branch from current main.
4. Inventory existing keypad/keyboard/authoring paths and produce the reuse/gap matrix before coding.
5. Prefer reuse and removal of duplicated plans over introduction of parallel mutation engines.
6. If P09-B is admitted, implement the smallest command-intent contract first with focused tests.
7. Add browser keyboard routing only after the command contract is stable.
8. Preserve exact semantic authority, unified history, renderer non-authority, current Piano/Violin behavior and mobile usability.
9. Run exact-head CI and WebKit gates. Diagnose root cause; never weaken a test simply to make CI green unless the test itself contradicts the authoritative contract.
10. At each completed stage, update architecture docs and this continuation handoff with exact commit/PR/CI evidence and the next remaining action.
11. Stop at any explicit human gate and report the exact evidence or approval needed from the user.
stop_conditions: A change would create a second canonical score/history authority.
The proposed keyboard workflow requires renderer geometry to decide musical identity.
A required semantic target cannot be proven current-revision exact.
A bundle ceiling must be increased without explicit architecture review.
Physical-device behavior is required but no real-device evidence exists.
The work crosses into production deployment, release, SesliTab cutover or Guitar reactivation without explicit approval.

reporting_contract.final_rule: Do not claim COMPLETE, production-ready, physical-device PASS or release-ready unless the evidence for that exact claim exists.
